video_title: Scoot Henderson Media Availability | Oct. 8, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on playing alongside Damian Lillard
quotes.excerpt: When I'm younger I'm looking up to some of my teammates in general.
quotes.quote: It feels good. Obviously you look up when I'm younger I'm looking up to some of my teammates in general and then to play alongside some of the guards that I used to watch, watch film on, study, even texted to for advice and things like that early on in my career and then to play alongside with them is kind of a full circle moment.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson calls playing alongside the guards he grew up studying a full circle moment. He says it feels good to share the floor with players he used to text for advice early in his career.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the team's emphasis on ball movement
quotes.excerpt: That's just how we should play with all the players that we have, the depth that we have.
quotes.quote: That's just how we should play with all the players that we have, the depth that we have. That's how we should play. Nobody should be trying to sprint the ball up the floor unless I get it or me and Damian Lillard get it or Shaedon Sharpe and we trying to race it down the floor. Other than that, that's how the game should be played.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson says the Blazers depth means they should prioritize ball movement. He noted that only he, Damian Lillard, or Shaedon Sharpe should be sprinting the ball up the floor.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the team's focus on getting everyone involved
quotes.excerpt: Chauncey Billups wants me to attack the basket, go to score.
quotes.quote: It made it easier for me just in a way of not trying to worry about focusing on getting everybody involved. That's the player I am. I get players involved, I get my teammates involved just as a player as I am. But I feel like focusing on attacking the basket, Chauncey Billups wants me to attack the basket, go to score. I think that just helps me get in that position of get downhill, find my open, find my teammates.
quotes.social_post: Chauncey Billups wants Scoot Henderson to focus on attacking the basket. Scoot says this shift helps him get downhill and makes it easier to find open teammates.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on Shaedon Sharpe's positive energy
quotes.excerpt: I've heard a couple times Damian Lillard talk about Shaedon Sharpe, he's seen a lot of joy out of him.
quotes.quote: I've heard a couple times Damian Lillard talk about Shaedon Sharpe, he's seen a lot of joy out of him these last few weeks here. I didn't know Shaedon Sharpe before and he never seemed like an angry person to me, looking from afar. He always seemed like a happy person, always dancing. And I feel like bringing that joy with him is going to help us as a team, as teammates, as a friend. I think that is just all around help us as an organization.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson says Shaedon Sharpe is bringing a new level of joy to the team. He believes that positive energy from Sharpe will help the organization as a whole.

quotes.speaker: Scoot Henderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson on the mentorship from teammates
quotes.excerpt: Damian Lillard has been a great mentor.
quotes.quote: Damian Lillard has been a great mentor just him getting here, a great teammate, a great friend. Most of it is just basketball related things and then also just hanging out outside of here. Just how to move around, how to move strategic and obviously not have my head in the wrong areas and things like that. He's been a great mentor.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson credits Damian Lillard for being a great mentor. He says Lillard has been teaching him how to move strategically and keep his head in the right areas both on and off the court.
